title: Widespread QSO-driven outflows in the early Universe
question: Do high-z QSOs show faint broad [CII] wings tracing cold outflows, detectable by stacking archival ALMA [CII] data?

data.sensitivity: ~0.3 to ~0.8 mJy/beam per 30 km/s channel for individual sources; stack 0.06 mJy/beam

what.value: Mrk231-like template used to compute L_FIR

evidence.quote: We computed the FIR luminosity by using an Mrk231-like template (cite: Polletta07)

what.value: AGN bolometric correction from 1450 A luminosity

evidence.quote: by applying the bolometric correction from (cite: Runnoe12)

what.value: Low-z AGN outflow energetics for comparison (30 AGN)

evidence.quote: the collection of 30 low redshift AGN by (cite: Flutsch18)

recipe.goal: Image archival data and subtract continuum
recipe.method: CASA clean cubes (Hogbom, natural, 0.05'' pixels, 30 km/s channels); zeroth-order uv-plane continuum fit to |v|>1500 km/s channels

recipe.goal: Extract spectra and fit [CII] core per source
recipe.method: Spectra from region of four beams; single Gaussian fit for redshift and core parameters
Variance-weighted stack with weights 1/sigma^2 per channel after aligning at [CII] rest frequency and centering on continuum peak; both 1D spectra and 3D cubes
key_parameters: n=48; channels with atmospheric transmission <0.5 excluded

recipe.method: chi2 minimisation with core Gaussian plus broad Gaussian, all parameters free, weights W'_k

recipe.goal: Size of outflow from stacked cube
recipe.method: Beam-deconvolved half-light radius of |v|>400 km/s map

recipe.goal: Outflow mass, rate, power, momentum load
recipe.method: Hailey-Dunsheath10 mass relation; Mdot=v M/R; Edot=0.5 Mdot v^2; momentum load vs L_AGN/c
assumptions: optically thin [CII], n>>n_crit, X_C+~1e-4, T=200 K, 0.7 PDR fraction

answer_key.quantity: FWHM of broad [CII] component, whole stack

evidence.quote: The significance estimated through the fitting analysis is $5.6\sigma$.
$R_{\rm out}$ corresponds to $\sim3.5$ kpc at $\langle z_{\rm stack}\rangle$.
a factor of $\sim14$ lower than that of the J1148$+$5251 observations of (cite: Cicone15)

not_stated_but_needed: List of the 48 QSOs with per-source flux scaling/calibration corrections (table not in text)
Exact clean threshold and iteration count per source
Which sources were calibrated manually vs pipeline
Exact aperture definition/centering and handling of channels with partial coverage
Initial guesses for the Gaussian fits
How the 100 empty positions were chosen
missing_for_reproduction: Source list table with per-source parameters not in text
score_reason: Public data, clear stacking recipe and numeric results, but sample table and per-source calibration details are missing.
rediscovery_reason: Data public, recipe mostly complete, results numeric.
